/audio/amaze-on/kokoro-heart/amaze-on-01.speechText: possessor. Definition: Someone who owns or has something. In this passage, Mrs. Sommers becomes the unexpected possessor of fifteen dollars.
judicious. Definition: Showing careful, sensible judgment. In this passage, Mrs. Sommers plans a judicious use of her money.
appreciable. Definition: Large enough to be noticed or to matter. In this passage, better shoes might last an appreciable time longer.

/audio/amaze-on/kokoro-heart/amaze-on-02.speechText: reproach. Definition: Blame or criticism expressing disapproval. In this passage, Scrooge fears the world’s reproach of poverty.
engrosses. Definition: Occupies someone’s attention completely. In this passage, Belle says that gaining wealth engrosses Scrooge.
fraught. Definition: Filled with something difficult or troubling. In this passage, their changed relationship is now fraught with misery.

/audio/amaze-on/kokoro-heart/amaze-on-03.speechText: engagements. Definition: Scheduled professional appearances or commitments. In this passage, the duke claims to have pressing London engagements.
tragedians. Definition: Actors who perform tragic drama. In this passage, the angry audience starts toward the tragedians.
splendid. Definition: Extremely good or impressive. In this passage, the customers call the disappointing show splendid.

/audio/amaze-on/kokoro-heart/amaze-on-04.speechText: Omnibus. Definition: a bus carrying a number of passengers. In this passage, Gatsby’s car becomes an omnibus for his guests.
Ravages. Definition: serious damage caused by something destructive. In this passage, servants repair the ravages of the party.
Harlequin. Definition: made up of patches of different colors. In this passage, the salads have colorful harlequin designs.

/audio/amaze-on/kokoro-heart/amaze-on-05.speechText: assimilated. Definition: Made increasingly similar or closely fitted to something. In this passage, worn garments become assimilated to their wearer.
improvidence. Definition: A lack of care or planning for future needs. In this passage, an unmended tear may reveal improvidence, not bad character.
prospects. Definition: Chances of future success or improvement. In this passage, people fear that patched trousers will ruin their prospects.

/audio/amaze-on/kokoro-heart/amaze-on-06.speechText: sordid. Definition: Morally unpleasant or mean-spirited. In this passage, the speaker calls material gain a sordid boon.
creed. Definition: A set of religious beliefs. In this passage, the speaker imagines following an ancient creed.
forlorn. Definition: Lonely, sad, or without hope. In this passage, an encounter with nature might leave him less forlorn.

/audio/amaze-on/kokoro-heart/amaze-on-07.speechText: alacrity. Definition: Eager readiness to do something. In this passage, Tom hides his alacrity when he gives up the brush.
covet. Definition: Strongly desire something. In this passage, making the task hard to obtain makes boys covet it.
resign. Definition: Give up a job or position. In this passage, the gentlemen would resign if driving became paid work.

/audio/amaze-on/kokoro-heart/amaze-on-08.speechText: impartial. Definition: Not favoring one side or influenced by a personal interest. In this passage, the FTC recommends looking for impartial expert reviews.
competitor. Definition: A person or business trying to attract the same customers. In this passage, a fake negative review can harm a competitor.
incentive. Definition: Something offered to encourage an action. In this passage, a free product can be an incentive for writing a review.

/audio/amaze-on/kokoro-heart/amaze-on-09.speechText: Aspiration. Definition: a strong hope or ambition. In this passage, an aspiration gives us something enjoyable to pursue.
Amulets. Definition: objects believed to bring protection or good fortune; here, a metaphor. In this passage, desire and curiosity are amulets that keep life interesting.
Allay. Definition: to calm or satisfy a feeling or desire. In this passage, complete knowledge would allay the desire to learn.

/audio/amaze-on/kokoro-heart/amaze-on-10.speechText: entity. Definition: An organization that exists as a separate unit. In this passage, a government entity may collect recyclable materials.
facility. Definition: A place equipped for a particular purpose. In this passage, a recovery facility sorts and cleans the materials.
asphalt. Definition: A dark paving material used to surface roads. In this passage, recovered glass can be used in asphalt.

/audio/amaze-on/kokoro-heart/amaze-on-11.speechText: Derail. Definition: to prevent a plan from succeeding. In this passage, unexpected situations can derail a healthy plan.
Impulses. Definition: sudden urges to act without much thought. In this passage, impulses can make immediate rewards hard to resist.
Gratification. Definition: pleasure from satisfying a desire. In this passage, postponing gratification means waiting for a reward.
